title: Inca Empire (c. 1438-1533)
key_facts: Sophisticated road network and agricultural terraces
No written language; used quipu knot system for record-keeping
Conquered by Francisco Pizarro with tiny force against vast empire
causes: Control of diverse ecological zones and resources
Advanced agricultural production supporting large population
outcome: Fall of Cusco ended Inca imperial rule
Spanish colonization and forced labor systems
Devastating population loss from disease and violence
Destruction of indigenous knowledge and cultural practices

figures.name: Atahualpa
figures.role: Last Inca emperor; captured by Pizarro

impacts: Created Spanish colonial empire in South America
Massive cultural genocide and knowledge destruction
Established mining economies that still affect region today
